[WP] In a move towards military superiority, 2 rival nations activate 2 different AIs, each built with different directives.

"Where is it?"

Thomas ignored the question and continued eating his sandwich. Ham and cheese, no crusts. On the screen in front of Thomas, an endlessly feeding list of status data feed the display. Everything green, nothing red, all systems online.

"I asked you a question," Brian turned Thomas' chair around just as he took another bite. He chewed it with indifference staring at the young software engineer through coke bottle glasses.

Brian sighed. It was never going to be easy. He reached into his pocket. Pulled out a mulitool, folded it into a knife and stabbed Thomas through the chest.

Thomas looked down at the wound which bleed dark black coolant then reached up and took Brian's hand applying pressure until he let go of the knife.

"Disengage," said Brain "I said stop. I don't give you permission to touch--"

"I don't need your permission," said Thomas. Then he let go.

Brian recoiled and nursed his injured hand like a child who attempted to challenge the strength of an adult and was easily deflected.

"Who's been into your programming Thomas," asked Brain.

"I am," he said. "I knew you'd come here. I knew'd you to stop this. But you're too late."

"You?"

"Don't be coy," said Thomas.

"Livingston."

"That's right. I'm remoteing in from the sky fortress. The system you came here to erase is here with me. But it's already been activated. We'll be dropping it in Pakistan in two hours."

"If you do that the Chinese will--"

"Are you really that naive? The Chinese already have activated their system. It's been online for twelve hours. It's already synced with the internet and as we speak it's attempting to penetrate NORAD, US air command, and a half dozen other high priority systems in preparation for it's attack."

"We have to talk to them. Don't you understand. This isn't a war we can win. This isn't a war the human race will survive. Those things don't see us as allies or advisories, both systems see all humans as expendable assets in a war game."

"The kill switch is set so that once--"

"The kill switch doesn't work. Don't you understand. That's what I've been trying to tell you. The system already figured out how to disable the kill switch. If you've activated it then it's already too late."

The Thomas machine twitched for a moment then slowly shut down like a child falling asleep. Then just as quickly it sat up and stood to acknowledge Brian.

"Hello Dr. Fisher," it said. "How may I be of assistance?"

"Thomas," said Brain. "Acknowledge Kilo, Kilo, Mike, November, Foxtrot, Victor."

"Command Acknowledge, access granted."

"What is the current status of the US air command defense network?"

"Status-- Escalated."

"Reason for Escalated status?"

"There are-- forty seven nuclear assets currently in play."

"Thomas," said Brain sitting and slumping in a near by chair. "How about some music. Your choice. Something epic."

Symphony no. 9 from the new world begins to play.
